visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens in a brightly lit indoor classroom featuring a green bulletin board with various papers. Four students, three males and one female, are wearing white school uniforms. They are laughing and talking. A tall male student with a backpack walks into the frame from the right side. The others react with visible surprise, looking up at him and making hand gestures to emphasize his newfound height. (2) The scene cuts to a medium shot of a female student with dyed blue hair. She wears a white school shirt. Her expression is skeptical yet amused as she talks to her peers. They lean in towards her, appearing to examine her chest area. Another female student is partially visible in the background, laughing heartily at the ongoing joke. (3) A final segment shows a male student who has grown a thick, dark beard during the break. His classmates are touching his facial hair and laughing loudly. The background is a plain white wall with school notices, maintaining the classroom setting. The camera stays at eye-level, capturing the group's dynamic interactions.
